notes.title: NashBored Patch Notes for February 1st, 2025
notes.notes:
Here's a little patch to fix some of the issues present in the Revisited update!
I hope you all have had a wonderful weekend, and I hope you'll enjoy NashBored!

[h3]Changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed Bug causing cutscene videos to not fill the entire screen in Fullscreen mode
[*]Fixed Mistake where there could be two Alexes on screen at once in the ending
[*]Redid a few face sprites
[*]Added mushrooms to the first area
[*]Added Smug Cape as a reward for beating a secret boss
[*]Minor Tileset changes and touch ups
[*]Fixed a bunch of typos
[/list]

Thanks for all of the support!
As always, if you run into any bugs or errors, or simply wish to give some feedback,
feel free to leave a comment below!

Thanks!
Karbonic

notes.title: NashBored: Revisited Update
notes.notes:
Six years ago, NashBored came out.
It's a game about dreams, and a game about the fear in life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34137953/0541a90ac85f730f781689a9bbad2116b8b4dc1b.png[/img]

After it came out, NashBored didn't receive any major updates, and so it sat there in its release state.

[b]Until now![/b]

I've decided to return to NashBored, to tune it up and get it running again. To make it more fun to play and to better match the initial vision of the game. This is a major update that changes a bunch of stuff within NashBored! I hope you will enjoy!

[h1]Big Changes:[/h1]

[b]Graphical Overhaul[/b]
NashBored was showing it's age. It was time for a visual refresh!
Characters have better looking faces and art, tons of sprites have been remade, and prerendered graphics have been rerendered to look much prettier!

Before:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34137953/652056b59b68b566e17dbd25f6a20151229fd397.png[/img]
After:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34137953/1f5f9b302a65cc24fc0e015984fd87b0a9bab026.png[/img]

Before:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34137953/13bdecee10c7fcefbce5f7f302e2e7289e3c5add.png[/img]
After:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34137953/d6376bd694b1f2421981cbf6e03db6d1abad09ea.png[/img]

[b]New Content[/b]
A bunch of new content has been added to the game!
New prerendered areas, new enemies, a ton of new music, it's going to feel cool to explore!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34137953/3a28c32d58c3e8c7fd0878d23aceced8aa73957b.png[/img]

[b]Battle System Overhaul[/b]
The battle system has been tweaked in a bunch of ways to make it more fair and fun to play!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34137953/39dec571a46700dec20241315930cc8455d48873.png[/img]

[b]Redone Challenge Areas[/b]
One sore spot of NashBored was the overworld challenge areas. They could often be unfun and unfair.
They have been completely remade from the ground up to be more fun and interesting to explore!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34137953/5769a161c1eb170962bb29f2acbac20467ce85ba.png[/img]

[b]Achievements![/b]
After Six Years, Achievements have finally been added to NashBored! Get them all and impress your friends!

[h1]Other Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated character graphics to be in line with DashBored
[*]New temporary party member added, Minbot
[*]Various overworld bugfixes
[*]Certain scenes have been rewritten to be more interesting
[*]Cutscene graphics have all been remade
[*]Character diagonal sprites have been added
[*]New hidden cutscenes and secrets added
[*]More equipment has been added to find
[*]Enemy sprites have all been redrawn
[*]Battle backgrounds have all been recreated
[/list]

notes.title: NashBored 1/6/19 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Here's a small little patch that will hopefully improve QoL a bit.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a few word wrapping errors/typos
[*]Changed the Chateau Challenge to be a bit more doable
[*]Removed lanterns blocking path in first challenge
[*]Added Face Sprite for Fairies
[*]Added new unique items to find in the world. More of a reward for Exploration!
[*]Made Poison Pockets slightly more expensive
[/list]

I'm hoping you enjoy this update!
[b]Have a good day![/b]
-Finn T.
